text: The winner takes it all. The loser has to fall.
author: ABBA
note: Released on the album 'Super Trouper' in 1980.

text: Identity does not arise from what we have, but from what we are not willing to lose.
author: Abbas Khider
original: Identität entsteht nicht aus dem, was wir haben, sondern aus dem, was wir nicht zu verlieren bereit sind. (DE)
note: Exact publication year unverified.

text: God does not play dice.
author: Albert Einstein
note: From a letter to Max Born, dated December 4, 1926.

text: The computer was born to solve problems that did not exist before.
author: Bill Gates
note: Widely attributed to Bill Gates; exact origin date unclear.

text: The world is full of the ruins of empires who thought they were eternal.
author: Camille Flammarion
original: L'histoire est pleine de ruines d'empires qui se croyaient éternels. (FR)
note: From his science fiction novel 'La Fin du Monde' (The Omega Point).

text: This world doesn’t like those who are different… Don’t let anyone tell you who you should be.
author: Carl Manfred (Detroit: Become Human)
note: In-universe timeline year for Detroit: Become Human.

text: Humanity's greatest achievement is once again going to be its greatest demise.
author: Elijah Kamski (Detroit: Become Human)
note: In-universe timeline year for Detroit: Become Human.

text: I tried so hard and got so far, but in the end, it doesn't even matter.
author: Chester Bennington (Linkin Park)
note: Released on the album 'Hybrid Theory' (Song: 'In the End').

text: Since you can't add days to your life, try adding life to your days.
author: Chinese Proverb
note: Commonly cited as a proverb; actual origin is widely debated and often attributed to others like Anne Hornal.

text: History isn’t the study of the past, but the study of previous presents.
author: E. H. Carr
note: From his foundational historiography book 'What Is History?'.

text: The only thing necessary for the triumph of evil is for good men to do nothing.
author: Edmund Burke (Attributed)
note: Often attributed to Burke, though similar sentiments were expressed by John Stuart Mill in 1867.

text: Become who you are.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
note: Prominently featured in 'Die fröhliche Wissenschaft' (The Gay Science).

text: Beware that, when fighting monsters, you yourself do not become a monster.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
original: Wer mit Ungeheuern kämpft, mag zusehn, dass er nicht dabei zum Ungeheuer wird. (DE)
note: From 'Jenseits von Gut und Böse' (Beyond Good and Evil), Aphorism 146.

text: God is dead! God remains dead! And we have killed him!
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
original: Gott ist tot! Gott bleibt tot! Und wir haben ihn getötet! (DE)
note: From 'Die fröhliche Wissenschaft' (The Gay Science), Section 125.

text: The further a society drifts from the truth, the more it will hate those who speak it.
author: Selwyn Duke (Attributed)
note: Often misattributed to George Orwell, but originally written by Selwyn Duke in a 2009 essay.

text: Those who do not know the past are condemned to repeat it.
author: George Santayana
note: From 'The Life of Reason: Reason in Common Sense'.

text: When writing the story of your life, don't let anyone else hold the pen.
author: Harley Davidson (Brand Slogan)
note: Marketing slogan; exact inception year varies by campaign.

text: You either die a hero, or you live long enough to see yourself become the villain.
author: Harvey Dent (The Dark Knight)
note: In-universe timeline year matches the film's release.

text: War is hell? No, war is war and hell is hell. And of the two, war is a lot worse. There are no innocent bystanders in hell. But war is chock-full of them.
author: Hawkeye Pierce (M*A*S*H)
note: Set during the Korean War (approx. 1950-1953). This specific quote is from the Season 5 episode 'The Illusion of Terror' (air date 1977).

text: The freedom of one person ends where the freedom of another begins.
author: Immanuel Kant
original: Die Freiheit eines Menschen endet dort, wo die Freiheit des anderen beginnt. (DE)
note: A common paraphrase of Kant's formulations in 'The Metaphysics of Morals'.

text: Humanity is code with bugs we cannot fix.
author: Jackstar
note: Original quote.

text: We measure not the world by what we see, but by what we choose to understand.
author: Jackstar
note: Original quote.

text: Nothing is more dangerous than a man who has nothing to lose.
author: James Baldwin (Attributed)
note: Often associated with themes in 'The Fire Next Time'.

text: Nothing is more dangerous than active ignorance.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
original: Es ist nichts schrecklicher als eine handelnde Unwissenheit. (DE)
note: From 'Maximen und Reflexionen'.

text: First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.
author: John Johnson
note: Popular software engineering adage.

text: You don't realize what you have until it's gone.
author: Joni Mitchell
note: Lyrics from the song 'Big Yellow Taxi'.

text: History is the sum of the things that could have been avoided.
author: Konrad Adenauer
original: Die Geschichte ist die Summe der Dinge, die hätten vermieden werden können. (DE)
note: Attributed to the former German Chancellor.

text: A single death is a tragedy; a million deaths is a statistic.
author: Kurt Tucholsky
original: Der Tod eines Menschen: das ist eine Katastrophe. Hunderttausend Tote: das ist eine Statistik! (DE)
note: From his essay 'Französischer Witz'. Often misattributed to Joseph Stalin.

text: An eye for an eye only ends up making the whole world blind.
author: Mahatma Gandhi (Attributed)
note: Widely attributed to Gandhi, but no definitive primary source confirms he originated it.

text: I have never seen God, but I have seen people who have committed murders in his name.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
note: Attributed to Gandhi regarding religious violence.

text: History is a set of lies agreed upon.
author: Napoleon Bonaparte
original: L'histoire est une suite de mensonges sur lesquels on est d'accord. (FR)
note: Widely attributed; popularized in English by various historians.

text: What's the meaning of a scar if we don't learn to heal?
author: Niall Horan

text: Some people are so poor, the only thing they have is money.
author: Patrick Meagher
note: Often shared as a modern aphorism.

text: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
note: Adapted from sentiments expressed in his essay 'Self-Reliance'.

text: Be loyal to what matters.
author: Arthur Morgan (Red Dead Redemption 2)
note: In-universe timeline year.

text: Vengeance is a fool’s game.
author: Arthur Morgan (Red Dead Redemption 2)
note: In-universe timeline year.

text: You don’t get to live a bad life and have good things happen to you.
author: Arthur Morgan (Red Dead Redemption 2)
note: In-universe timeline year.

text: That's the way it is.
author: Daniel Lanois (Red Dead Redemption 2)
note: Official release year of the song on the Red Dead Redemption 2 soundtrack.

text: I only wish I had acquired wisdom at less of a price.
author: Hosea Matthews (Red Dead Redemption 2)
note: In-universe timeline year.

text: We can’t fight change.
author: Dutch van der Linde (Red Dead Redemption 1 & 2)
note: Famously spoken during the timeline of the first game (1911).

text: Take a chance that love exists and do a loving act.
author: Sister Calderón (Red Dead Redemption 2)
note: In-universe timeline year.

text: If the majority simply does nothing, a few extremists are enough.
author: Rezo (German YouTuber)
original: Wenn die meisten einfach gar nichts machen, reichen ein paar Spinner aus. (DE)
note: From his viral political commentary videos.

text: Just because something was a certain way once doesn't mean it can't be that way again.
author: Rezo (German YouTuber)
original: Nur weil etwas schonmal so war, kann es doch nochmal so sein. (DE)
note: From his viral political commentary videos.

text: The real danger is not that computers will begin to think like men, but that men will begin to think like computers.
author: Sydney J. Harris
note: From his syndicated column 'Strictly Personal'.

text: The right man in the wrong place can make all the difference in the world.
author: The G-Man (Half-Life 2)
note: Approximate in-universe timeline year; Half-Life 2 is set nearly two decades after the Black Mesa Incident.

text: What the human being is best at doing is interpreting all new information so that their prior conclusions remain intact.
author: Warren Buffett
note: From a Berkshire Hathaway annual meeting/report.

text: A people that forgets its past has no future.
author: Winston Churchill
note: Often quoted as Churchill; heavily derived from earlier philosophies like Santayana's.

text: History is written by the victors.
author: Winston Churchill (Attributed)
note: Commonly attributed to Churchill, but origins are untraced.

text: If you are going through hell, keep going! It ain't a place to stop!
author: Winston Churchill
note: Popularly attributed to Churchill, though no primary written record of him saying it exists.

text: If someone is trying to bring you down, it means they are already below you.
author: Ziad K. Abdelnour
note: From his book 'Economic Warfare: Secrets of Wealth Creation'.

text: The greatest failure is to never start.
note: General motivational proverb.

text: There is a huge difference between believing you know, and knowing you believe.
note: Philosophical adage.

text: We are living in a world where technology allows us to communicate instantly, yet isolates us profoundly.
note: Modern social commentary.

text: Somewhere in the universe, somewhere someone's got it worse
author: AJR (American Pop Band)
note: Lyrics from the song 'World's Smallest Violin'.

text: Heroes die so that legends can be born
note: Common narrative trope.

text: [I] gave up who I am for who you wanted me to be
author: Emily Armstrong (Linkin Park)
note: Lyrics from the song 'The Emptiness Machine'.

text: Despite my best efforts to the contrary, it turns out I've won.
author: Arthur Morgan (Red Dead Redemption 2)
note: In-universe timeline year.

text: In their last moments, people show you who they really are
author: The Joker
note: In-universe timeline year for The Dark Knight.

text: Don't fight because you hate who's in front of you. Fight because you love what's behind you.
author: G.K. Chesterton
original: The true soldier fights not because he hates what is in front of him, but because he loves what is behind him. (EN)
note: Originally published in the 'Illustrated London News'.

text: The sad thing is good people do bad things
author: Hosea Matthews (Red Dead Redemption 2)
note: In-universe timeline year.

text: Live in the present. You'll miss it in the future.
note: General advice.

text: When saving lives, don't forget to save yours along the way.
note: First responder/caretaker adage.

text: Nobody made my path but me.
author: John Marston (Red Dead Redemption 1)
note: In-universe timeline year for the first game.

text: A bad cause seldom fails to betray itself
author: James Madison
note: From Federalist No. 41.

text: 'It was cheaper' will eventually be written on the gravestone of humanity.
note: Modern economic/environmental commentary.

text: I am so clever that sometimes I don't understand a single word of what I am saying.
author: Oscar Wilde
note: From the short story 'The Remarkable Rocket'.

text: I tried to break my own heart just to see if I still could, but I missed the mark and accidentally fell in love instead.
note: Unknown poetry.

text: It turns out that being a good person is just a series of very inconvenient mistakes.
author: Jackstar
note: Original quote.

text: The democratization of information has, paradoxically, made the truth harder to find than ever before.
author: Jackstar
note: Original quote.

text: I'll do, whatever it takes.
author: Imagine Dragons
note: Lyrics from the song 'Whatever It Takes'.

text: Past is who we are
author: John Marston (Red Dead Redemption 1)
note: In-universe timeline year.

text: It's [already] been decided how we lose.
author: Emily Armstrong (Linkin Park)
note: Lyrics from the song 'Heavy Is the Crown'.

text: Sometimes you win, sometimes you learn.
author: John C. Maxwell
note: Title of his popular book on leadership and failure.

text: Comparison is the thief of joy.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
note: Often attributed to Roosevelt; exact date of origin is undocumented.

text: One moment of patience, in a moment of anger can save a thousand moments of regret.
author: Chinese Proverb
note: Traditional proverb.

text: If you choose not to decide, you still have made a choice.
author: Neil Peart (Rush)
note: Lyrics from the song 'Freewill' (Permanent Waves album).

text: Everyone you meet is fighting a battle you know nothing about. Be kind. Always.
note: Widely attributed to Ian Maclaren (Rev. John Watson) originally in 1898.

text: If you do things right, people won’t be sure you’ve done anything at all.
author: Ken Keeler
note: In-universe year. Quote by the 'God' entity in Futurama episode 'Godfellas', written by Ken Keeler.

text: It's hard to win an argument with a smart person, but it's damn near impossible to win an argument with a stupid person.
author: Bill Murray
note: Often attributed to Bill Murray in modern meme culture.

text: Common sense isn't so common.
author: Voltaire
original: Le sens commun n'est pas si commun. (FR)
note: From his 'Dictionnaire Philosophique' (Philosophical Dictionary).

text: What's past is past, who cares? My soul: 'Objection!'
author: Alligatoah
original: Vorbei ist vorbei, juckt. Meine Seele so: Einspruch
note: From the song 'Nachbeben' (Aftershocks) (released on the album 'Rotz & Wasser')

text: Take care of your soul, there are no prosthetics for that.
author: Alligatoah
original: Pass auf deine Seele auf, dafür gibt's keinen Prothesenbau
note: Outro line from the song 'Nachbeben' (2022) by Alligatoah, highlighting that physical injuries can be replaced or patched up with prosthetics, but psychological and emotional damage is irreplaceable.

text: The nice thing about being duped is that in the end, you are un-duped.
author: Pizzera & Jaus (Austrian Pop Duo)
original: Des scheene am enttäuscht sein is, du bist daunn ent-täuscht
note: Line form their song 'eine ins leben' (into the life) (2017).
